reasoning_content:
ss returned nothing for port 3000, and pgrep -x node returned nothing either. That's odd. Wait — the app was serving /health/live a moment ago. Let me check if the app is still running. Maybe the `timeout 600` wrapper killed something, or the dev server process tree got reaped. Actually, the earlier poll loop used `curl` and got 200. Let me re-check.

Actually the issue: `pgrep -x node` might not match because the process name is truncated. Let me check more carefully. Also ss -ltnp may need different args. Let me just curl again.

action.command: curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'live HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3000/health/live 2>&1; echo "--- procs ---"; ps aux | grep -E 'nx run|vite|node' | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2, $11, $12, $13, $14}' | head -20; echo "--- port ---"; (ss -ltn 2>/dev/null || netstat -ltn 2>/dev/null) | grep -E '3000|LISTEN' | head
